title: Scalar Functions
description: Learn how to create scalar functions that return a single value.

data.text: A scalar function takes one or more parameters and returns a single value. Scalar functions help simplify code by encapsulating complex formulas or business logic.

data.title: Scalar function syntax
data.content: Creates a scalar function that returns a decimal value.
data.code:
CREATE FUNCTION [schema_name.]function_name (parameter_list)
RETURNS data_type AS
BEGIN
    statements
    RETURN value
END

data.title: ALTER FUNCTION syntax
data.code:
ALTER FUNCTION [schema_name.]function_name (parameter_list)
    RETURN data_type AS
    BEGIN
        statements
        RETURN value
    END

data.title: DROP FUNCTION syntax
data.content: Removes a scalar function from the database.

data.title: Scalar Functions Key Points
points: Scalar functions return a single value.
They must include a RETURN statement.
Scalar functions can be used anywhere in T-SQL statements.
Use CREATE OR ALTER to create or modify a function.
